
This folder: Weather data contains climatic data used as input for the simaulton runs		

Description of the weather files		
File name	Country	     Site
SARS.WTH        Egypt       Sakha
MNFY.WTH	Egypt     Menofya
BSUF.WTH        Egypt     Benisuef
ASWN.WTH        Egypt        Aswan


# varaible names and units         Units
SRAD- solar radiation              MJ/m2/day    
TMAX- Maximum air temperature      oC
TMIN- Minimum air temerature       oC
RAIN- Rain                         mm
